author: "[এখানে আপনার নাম লিখুন]"

  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 3
    number_sections: false
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

input_file <- knitr::current_input()
if (is.null(input_file) || !nzchar(input_file)) {
  input_file <- "PROJECT_REPORT.Rmd"
}
input_dir <- dirname(normalizePath(input_file, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE))
report_file <- file.path(input_dir, "PROJECT_REPORT.md")
if (!file.exists(report_file)) {
  report_file <- file.path(getwd(), "PROJECT_REPORT.md")
}
if (!file.exists(report_file)) {
  stop("PROJECT_REPORT.md fileটি PROJECT_REPORT.Rmd-এর পাশে রাখুন।")
}
```

এই R Markdown document পাশের `PROJECT_REPORT.md` থেকে report content নেয়। RStudio-তে **Knit** চাপলে HTML report তৈরি হবে। `.md` ও `.Rmd` একই folder-এ রাখুন।

```{r render-project-report, results='asis'}
report_text <- readLines(report_file, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
cat(report_text, sep = "\n")
```
